jobs.title: Director, Fraud Agentic AI
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What's the opportunity?**


You will deliver innovative Agentic AI capabilities across Credit \& Fraud Management(CFM). You will combine strong strategy, business and product expertise to shape AI solutions, including Large Language Models(LLM)\-based and Agentic AI solutions. You will ensure the Data Science \& AI (DSA) team's strengths and efforts are consistently directed toward the highest\-impact problems, integrate seamlessly into end\-user workflows and create measurable business value. You will collaborate with stakeholders across diverse disciplines (DSA, IT, Fraud Operations, and Strategy), partner with business leaders to identify the right problems to solve with Agentic AI, work with the DSA team to translate problems into well\-scoped solutions and stay close to end\-users to ensure solutions have high adoption.
  

  

**What will you do?**

* Develop and communicate a clear strategy and roadmap for the team’s Agentic AI portfolio, aligned with broader CFM priorities, and assess business cases and expected ROI of potential Agentic AI solutions
* Act as the business owner for the team’s portfolio, liaising with stakeholders across the development lifecycle to ensure alignment, momentum, and business value capture, and develop a deep understanding of end\-user workflows, ensuring solutions integrate into those workflows seamlessly
* Build a working understanding of the business’ technology stack, and guide DSA and IT on which platforms, systems, and data sources our solutions should integrate with, and how
* Help DSA translate business requirements into a clear development plan and define business and technical success metrics for each solution, and put in place the measurement mechanisms needed to track performance against them through and beyond deployment
* Lead by example, championing a test\-and\-learn approach to Agentic AI product development, promoting experimentation, structured pilots and the use of evidence to drive decisions about scaling, iterating, or sunsetting solutions
* Perform Hands\-on agentic development work, modeling best practices in system design, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and solution architecture for the team
* Contribute directly to critical path development efforts, take ownership of key technical components, demonstrate excellence in agentic AI implementation and mentor the agentic development team through collaborative code reviews, technical pairing and knowledge transfer sessions

 **What you need to succeed**

**Must have:**

* 7\+ years of related work experience in Product Management, Fintech, AI Consulting, within a product/service domain (i.e. Fraud), and a strong knowledge of Fraud products and Fraud\-related applications
* 7\+ years of business experience, preferably within the financial industry and relevant line of business (i.e. Fraud Data Science or AI)
* Proven experience as a Senior Product Owner, having implemented products that drive business impact and user satisfaction, and a track record of identifying high\-impact business problems and delivering technology solutions that produced measurable business outcomes
* Solid hands\-on experience with AI technologies and understanding of how they’re formed into an AI product and strategy (e.g. LLMs, Agentic AI), and ability to translate business needs into clear product and technical requirements, including translating complex technical solutions back into simple business language
* Ability to lead a team that delivers for multiple stakeholders, despite ambiguity and scarce resources and influence partners over whom you have no formal authority
* Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, analytical judgment, experienced in building business cases, defining success metrics, using data to drive decisions and designing solutions with a user\-first mentality
* Exceptional time management and organizational skills; managing multiple AI products simultaneously
* Professional communication and facilitation skills, ability to develop executive\-level materials and lead working sessions with senior leaders
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, quantitative discipline, or equivalent related professional experience

 **Nice to have:**

* MA or MBA in a related field
* Certified Product Owner
* Agile/ SAFE Certification

 **What’s in it for you?**


We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

* A comprehensive Total Rewards Program
* Leaders who support your development
* Ability to make a difference and lasting impact

jobs.title: Director , eDiscovery- Technology Consulting
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.
  

  

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side\-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.
  

  

Are you ready to make your impact?


**About the Role**

  

This Director position is within FTI Consulting's Technology practice. FTI Technology utilizes modern review platforms for native document review and case management. Our practice primarily provides professional consulting services to corporations and law firms for coordinating document review and production using Relativity and/or Nuix Discover. The Director will be responsible for managing multiple aspects of specific client matters.

  

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who:


* Is technically minded \- all our work requires thinking in a logical, mathematical way about processes and sets of data
* Works flexibly with a variety of team members \- we work on a variety of projects at the same time, each of which can be staffed differently
* Is eager and excited to learn \- a positive, open\-minded attitude will ensure quality work and bodes well for long\-term career development
* Works hard \- while we do innovate, everyone has regular assigned tasks that are part of the overall workflow and on which high quality client service depends
* Enjoys solving the impossible \- we often receive requests that require us to consider difficult questions and develop new processes
  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Have responsibility for day\-to\-day activities of projects including interaction with other consultants, supervisors, and client personnel
* Apply analytical skills and leverage existing methodologies to various client situations and practice disciplines and create novel, customized solutions to meet shifting client needs
* Utilize logical reasoning skills to provide complete client service
* Work to ensure a quality product and delivery of all work within established timeframes.
* Introduce additional FTI services to clients as needs dictate
* Provide superior client service in demanding, deadline\-driven situations
* Maintain professional image within the firm and project same to those outside the firm
  

**How You Will Grow**

  

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on\-the\-job learning, self\-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

  

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

  

**What You Will Need To Succeed**

  

Basic Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree required
* 6\+ relevant experience utilizing eDiscovery technology (Relativity, Nuix Discover, and/or Reveal)
* Ability to travel to clients and FTI office(s) as needed
* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in Canada on a full\-time basis; this position does not provide visa sponsorship
  

Preferred Qualifications


* Strong proficiency with Windows and related software, such as Microsoft Excel
* Familiarity with Microsoft Access and SharePoint
* Excellent communication and client interface skills
* Outstanding client service in demanding, deadline–driven situations
* Ability to work independently in fast\-paced, multi\-task environment
  

  

***FTI Consulting is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.***

  

Compensation
  

  

Minimum Pay:$125,000\.00CAD
  

Maximum Pay:$159,500\.00CAD

jobs.title: Vice President, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
locationMarkham, ON*,* 302 Town Centre Blvd. categoryOther Job ID: VICEP079700 Full\-Time Oct 7 2026
  
JOB DESCRIPTION
At Sienna, we empower our team members across Ontario, British Columbia, Saskatchewan and Alberta to help our residents live the life they desire and deserve. Our purpose is simple: **to cultivate happiness in daily life!**


**What Sienna Offers:** We aspire to cultivate an environment and culture where team members feel valued, heard and empowered to do meaningful work. We offer a number of programs and benefits that support team members’ financial, personal and professional needs:


* A competitive compensation and vacation package
* Employer Paid Health \& Dental Benefits
* RRSP with Company Match
* Share Ownership and Reward Program (SOAR)
* Employee Share Purchase Plan with Company Match
* Continuous learning and growth so you have the skillset needed to succeed and take on new challenges
* A welcoming culture that values diversity and differing perspectives, experiences and beliefs

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer \& Executive Vice President, Investments, the Vice President, Corporate Strategy serves as a trusted advisor to the Executive Team and senior leaders across the organization. The role is responsible for accelerating Sienna's most important growth, innovation, and business improvement opportunities by bringing structure, analytical rigor, and cross\-functional leadership to strategic initiatives.


Working in partnership with business leaders, the Vice President leads the evaluation of strategic opportunities, development of business cases, assessment of risks and market dynamics, and creation of implementation roadmaps that support informed decision\-making and successful execution. Strategic initiatives remain owned by the appropriate operating or functional leader, with Corporate Strategy providing the dedicated capacity and expertise required to move opportunities from concept to execution\-ready plans.


This hands\-on role provides leadership in enterprise strategy, innovation, market intelligence, and growth opportunities. With the support of an analyst, the role also supports the annual strategic planning cycle.


**How You’ll Succeed:**


* Identify, evaluate, and advance high\-priority strategic growth and business improvement opportunities aligned with Sienna’s long\-term objectives.
* Transform early\-stage concepts into well\-defined strategic initiatives supported by rigorous analysis and actionable recommendations.
* Partner with executive leaders to assess opportunities related to growth, innovation, workforce transformation, new services, ancillary revenue streams, operational excellence, and business model innovation.
* Lead comprehensive assessments of strategic opportunities through market research, customer insights, competitive analysis, operational feasibility reviews, financial modeling, and risk evaluation.
* Develop robust business cases that clearly articulate value creation opportunities, investment requirements, implementation considerations, risks, and anticipated returns.
* Conduct scenario analysis and evaluate strategic alternatives to support executive decision\-making.
* Establish consistent methodologies and frameworks for evaluating strategic initiatives and growth opportunities across the organization.
* Create and implement a disciplined approach to evaluating, prioritizing, piloting, and scaling new business opportunities.
* Develop recommendations regarding market entry, service innovation, customer experience improvements, and long\-term growth strategies.
* Evaluate strategic opportunities through the lens of resident experience, team member engagement, operational effectiveness, and shareholder value creation.
* Monitor industry trends, demographic shifts, consumer preferences, competitive activity, policy developments, regulatory changes, and emerging market opportunities affecting the seniors living, healthcare, and hospitality sectors.
* Assess external market dynamics and competitive developments to identify opportunities and risks affecting Sienna’s strategic direction.
* Provide executive leadership with actionable insights regarding emerging trends and strategic implications for the organization.
* Establish clear accountabilities, deliverables, timelines, and decision\-making frameworks for strategic initiatives.
* Develop implementation roadmaps outlining resource requirements, milestones, risks, economic impacts, governance considerations, and measures of success.
* Support the design and launch of pilots and proof\-of\-concept initiatives.
* Support business leaders through the early stages of implementation before transitioning ongoing accountability to operational ownership.
* Partner with the CEO, CFO, Executive Team, on key enterprise strategic priorities.
* Support the development and execution of Sienna’s long\-term strategic plan, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, growth priorities, and financial goals.
* Support annual and multi\-year strategic planning activities.
* Prepare executive\-level reports, presentations, and recommendations for senior leadership and Board discussions.

**Who you are:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Public Policy, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
* MBA from a leading business school strongly preferred.
* Additional postgraduate education in Strategy, Finance, Economics, Organizational Leadership, Healthcare Administration, or related disciplines is considered an asset.
* 10 to 15 years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, business transformation, operations, corporate development, or related executive leadership roles.
* Significant experience within a leading strategy consulting firm or an equivalent strategic advisory environment.
* Demonstrated experience partnering directly with executive leadership teams
